conn.help.linux: Add your user to the group "vlt" (sudo usermod -aG vlt $USER). Then log out and log in again.
conn.help.windows: Add your user to the group "VLT Operators" (Computer Management > Local Users and Groups). Then log out and log in again.
conn.reason.connection_lost: The connection to vltd was lost
conn.reason.not_running: vltd does not run or the endpoint is not there
conn.reason.protocol: The vltd protocol is not compatible
conn.retry: VLT tries to connect again every 5 seconds.
demo.shutdown: Demo: the computer would shut down now.
device.allowed_ports: Serial ports for "automatic" (separate with commas; empty: no serial port)
device.busy.help: Another program uses this port. Stop UPSilon 2000 and the RupsMon service, or the other program, then try again.
device.demo.leave: Leave demo mode and connect to a real UPS? Events and measurements of the demo stay, marked as demo.
device.test.leave: Leave the test connection and connect to a real UPS? Events and measurements of the test stay, marked as test.
device.test.notfound: Start vlt-simulator.exe, then wait. VoltioVolt connects automatically.
device.test.shutdown: Test: the computer would shut down now.
device.test.real_shutdown: Permit a real computer shutdown in a test
device.test.real_shutdown.warn: With this setting on, a test can turn off this computer.
device.hid.permission.help: Your user cannot open this HID device. As an example, make a udev rule, then unplug and plug the device: KERNEL=="hidraw*", SUBSYSTEM=="hidraw", ATTRS{idVendor}=="0665", MODE="0660", GROUP="dialout".
device.port.permission.help: Your user cannot open this port. Run this command one time, then log out and log in: sudo usermod -aG dialout <user name>
device.confirm: VLT saves the Device settings and starts a new detection of the UPS. The monitoring stops for some seconds. Continue?
device.line.unchanged: unchanged (VLT does not set the line)
device.notconfigured.help: VLT sends no data to a port until you select one. Use the port list below, or select a Transport in the Device settings.
device.ports.mark.label: Mark {name}
device.ports.name: Port
device.ports.none: The operating system shows no serial port.
device.ports.use.confirm: VLT uses the port {name} with the Transport "serial" and starts a new detection of the UPS. Continue?
device.ports.use.label: Use the port {name}
device.saved: The Device settings are saved. A new detection started.
device.scan.label: Type {text} to scan the marked ports
device.scan.result.busy: busy (another program or VLT uses the port)
device.scan.warning: VLT sends the text Q1 to each marked port. Mark only ports with a UPS.
err.blocked: Too many wrong PINs. Wait for the block time.
err.control_busy: Another UPS Control request runs. Wait and try again.
err.countdown_active: A shutdown countdown runs. A test is not possible now.
err.low_battery: LOW_BATTERY is active. The countdown cannot be cancelled.
err.no_simulation: Run a passed Simulation of the current policy first.
err.not_supported: The UPS does not support this function.
err.not_verified: The UPS status did not confirm the command.
err.on_battery: The UPS is on battery. A test is not possible now.
err.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait and try again.
err.send_failed: The test message was not sent.
err.unavailable: This part of vltd does not run.
err.unknown_method: vltd does not know this function. Update VLT.
err.vault_locked: The Vault is locked. VLT uses the Fallback Policy; you cannot change the policy now.
fallback.banner: The Vault is locked. VLT uses the Fallback Policy.
general.dataDir.help: VoltioVolt keeps its files in this folder.
general.lang.notsaved: The language is changed for this session. Set a PIN to save it.
general.startAtLogon.help: When this is on, VoltioVolt starts when you log on. It uses only the startup folder of your user. Default: off.
general.theme.os: The theme follows the setting of the operating system (light or dark).
help.battery: Used only when the UPS does not report the charge. Keep the defaults unless you know the battery data.
help.battery.block_empty: Empty voltage of one 12 V block (standby).
help.battery.block_full: Full voltage of one 12 V block (standby).
help.battery.title: Battery estimate
help.dataDir: This folder holds the database, the Vault, the logs and the audit log. Make a copy of this folder to keep your history.
help.dtr: Keep the default (unchanged) unless the UPS does not answer.
help.email.gmail: Use a Google app password, not your normal password.
help.email.gmail.more: Steps: turn on 2-Step Verification, make an app password, paste the 16-character app password (not the normal password). Example user: name@gmail.com.
help.email.server: Ask your e-mail provider for these values.
help.pin: A PIN prevents other people at this computer from changing the shutdown settings.
help.policy.countdown_seconds: Time to save your work before the shutdown.
help.policy.trigger.charge_below_percent: Shut down when the battery charge is below this percent.
help.policy.trigger.comm_lost_on_battery: Shut down after this many seconds if communication is lost while on battery.
180 = shut down after 3 minutes without communication on battery. 0 = off.
help.policy.trigger.low_battery_flag: Shut down when the UPS reports the LOW_BATTERY flag.
help.policy.trigger.on_battery_seconds: Shut down after this many seconds on battery.
help.policy.trigger.on_battery_seconds.m: 300 = shut down after 5 minutes on battery.
help.policy.trigger.runtime_below_minute: Shut down when the remaining runtime is below this many minutes.
5 = shut down when less than 5 minutes remain. 0 = off.
help.policy.ups_off.example: Power fails, after 5 min the computer shuts down, 2 min later the UPS turns off, 1 min later it turns on again.
help.serial: A COM port is the serial connection of the computer to the UPS.
help.serial.more: On Windows, open Device Manager and look at "Ports (COM & LPT)". Example: COM3. On Linux, the port is often /dev/ttyUSB0.
help.severity: INFO is a normal change, WARNING needs attention, and CRITICAL is a serious problem.
help.severity.more: INFO example: the UPS returns to mains power. WARNING example: the UPS is on battery. CRITICAL example: the battery is low.
help.telegram.pair: Open your bot in Telegram, send "/start" and the 6-digit code.
help.telegram.pair.more: The chat appears in the list. Then send /durum to test.
help.telegram.token: Get a token from Telegram @BotFather, then paste it here.
help.telegram.token.more: Steps: (1) In Telegram, open @BotFather. (2) Send /newbot. (3) Give a name and a user name that ends with "bot". (4) BotFather sends the token. Copy it here. Example format: 123456789:ABCdefGhIJKlmNoPQRsTUVwxyZ (fake).
hist.table: Show the values as a table
hist.table.caption: {title}: {n} of {total} points
locked.need: Unlock with your PIN to use this function.
wizard.unlock.intro: This step needs your PIN. Enter it here to continue the wizard.
lock.screen.title: VoltioVolt is locked
lock.screen.intro: Enter your PIN to change settings. The Dashboard stays visible.
login.blocked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {seconds} s.
login.forgot.text: This removes the PIN and deletes all saved passwords and tokens (Telegram, e-mail). The automatic shutdown becomes inactive. Your settings and your history stay.
login.title: Unlock
nav.label: Screens
notify.email.gmail.help: Use a Google app password, not your normal password. Google account, Security, 2-Step Verification, App passwords.
notify.email.to: Receiver addresses (one on each line, 1 to 5)
notify.secret.hint: Set. Hint (last characters): {hint}. The value is write-only.
notify.secret.unset: Not set. The value is write-only: after you save it, VLT shows only a hint.
notify.telegram.code: The code is {code}. It expires at {until}. In Telegram, send this message to the bot: /start {code}
notify.telegram.steps: The VLT GUI shows a 6-digit code. In Telegram, open the bot and send: /start and the code. The code expires after 10 minutes.
pin.change.title: Change PIN
pin.changed: The PIN is changed. Unlock again with the new PIN.
pin.err.chars: The PIN can contain only A–Z, a–z and 0–9.
pin.err.length: The PIN must have 6 to 64 characters.
pin.err.mismatch: The two PINs are not the same.
pin.label: PIN
pin.remove.intro: Enter the current PIN to remove it. Without a PIN, all functions are available.
pin.remove.title: Remove PIN
pin.rules.chars: Only the letters A–Z, a–z and the digits 0–9.
pin.rules.common: Not a common PIN (for example 123123 or qwerty).
pin.rules.simple: Not the same character only and not a simple sequence (for example 123456 or abcdef).
pin.rules.title: PIN rules
pin.set.intro: Set a PIN for VLT. You need the PIN to change Settings and the Shutdown Policy.
pin.set.title: Set PIN
policy.activate.confirm: This computer will turn off automatically when the trigger conditions occur.
policy.activate.rule: Activate is possible only after a passed Simulation of the current version.
policy.deactivate.confirm: VLT will not turn off this computer automatically. Deactivate the Shutdown Policy?
policy.f.cancel_when_mains_returns: Cancel the countdown when mains power returns
policy.f.trigger.low_battery_flag: Trigger: LOW_BATTERY flag of the UPS
policy.f.ups_off.enabled: Turn off the UPS output after the shutdown starts
policy.saved: The policy is now inactive. Run the Simulation to activate it.
policy.upsoff.text: The UPS turns off its output {delay} minutes after the shutdown starts. The computer must shut down in less time. The UPS turns on its output {restore} minutes later.
policy.upsoff.title: UPS output off
policy.upsoff.warning: WARNING: An incorrect delay can turn off the power before the computer has shut down. Data can be lost.
policy.warning: WARNING: This screen controls the automatic shutdown of this computer. A wrong value can turn off the computer at the wrong time.
reset.done: The Vault is reset. All Secrets are deleted.
reset.explain: A Vault reset deletes all Secrets (for example passwords and tokens of channels). VLT cannot restore them. You must enter them again.
reset.label: Type {text} to confirm
reset.title: Vault reset
sd.title: Shutdown status
sim.k.ups_off: UPS output off command (dry run, not sent)
sim.k.ups_off_failed: UPS output off command failed (dry run)
sim.os_shutdown.error: This user cannot shut down the computer.
sim.title: Simulation
tray.quitConfirm: If you quit, VoltioVolt stops the monitoring and the automatic shutdown.
tray.stillMonitoring: VoltioVolt continues to monitor the UPS in the tray.
ups.busy: VLT sends the command and checks the UPS status.
ups.noups: No UPS is connected. The functions are not available.
ups.r.nosend: The beeper is already in this state. VLT sent nothing.
ups.r.notverified: The UPS status did not confirm the command {bytes} (sends: {sends}).
ups.r.verified: The UPS status confirmed the command {bytes} (sends: {sends}).
ups.test.confirm: The UPS changes to battery for the test. Start the test?
ups.test.low.label: Type {text} to start the test until battery low
ups.test.low.start: Start the test until battery low
ups.test.low.warning: WARNING: This test discharges the battery until it is low. The protected equipment has less battery time after the test until the battery is charged again.
ups.test.minutes.label: Test time in minutes
vault.reduced: Reduced protection: this computer has no TPM2. The Vault key is protected by the host key only (SEC-005). A person with root access to this computer can read the Secrets.
vault.title: Vault
wizard.general.intro: You can run the setup wizard again to select the port, the Shutdown Policy and the Notifications.
wizard.intro: These steps prepare VoltioVolt: the PIN, the UPS port, the Shutdown Policy and the Notifications.
wizard.modem.question: Are the modem and the router connected to the UPS?
wizard.modem.warn: During a power failure, the internet stops. Telegram and e-mail cannot send messages.
wizard.notify.intro.email: Optional: set the e-mail Channel (for example the Gmail preset). You can Skip this step.
wizard.notify.intro.telegram: Optional: set the Telegram bot token and pair a chat. You can Skip this step.
wizard.policy.intro: These are the default settings of the Shutdown Policy. Run the Simulation, then activate the policy.
wizard.pin.help: A PIN prevents other people at this computer from changing the shutdown settings.
wizard.port.intro: Select the UPS port. You can Scan the marked ports. Use "Use this port" to select one.
wizard.prompt.title: Start the setup wizard?
wizard.title: Setup wizard
wizard.values.intro: Check that the live values from the UPS are correct.
wizard.values.wait: VLT has no connection to the UPS yet. You can wait, or Skip this step.
mode.ui.title: Interface mode
mode.ui.help: Simple shows one screen with the most important information. Expert shows all screens and settings.
wizard.interface.intro: Choose how VoltioVolt looks. You can change it later in the View menu or in the settings.
simple.auto.off: Off. The computer does not shut down automatically.
simple.trigger: The computer {action} after {battery} min on battery, or when the runtime is below {runtime} min or the charge is below {charge} %.
health.ups_shutdown: The UPS turns off its output soon.
health.on_battery: Power failure: the UPS runs on battery.
health.avr: The UPS corrects the mains voltage (AVR).
health.bypass: The UPS is in bypass: the battery does not protect the computer.
plain.AVR_ACTIVE: The UPS corrects the mains voltage (AVR)
plain.UPS_SHUTDOWN_ACTIVE: The UPS turns off its output
health.good.sentence: Everything is fine. The UPS runs on mains power.
scale.title: Interface size
scale.help: Ctrl+Plus and Ctrl+Minus change the size. Ctrl+0 sets Auto.
scale.used: The screen is too small: VoltioVolt uses {n} %.
scale.reduced: The interface size {want} does not fit on this screen. VoltioVolt uses {used} %.
